authorization: User approved reconciliation of original fixed10k frame with all existing semantic reviews; this is not new semantic reading or a new sample.

target.source: existing frozen exact-text cache; verify actual frame conservation in scheduled job

questions: Which field-level judgments already exist with exact provenance?
Which reviewed outcomes remain explicitly unknown or conflicted?
Which fields were never semantically judged?
How many unique full contexts require new work, separately from unresolved reviewed cases?
source_priority: Final Formal800 consolidated artifact (including root and conflict masking); never reapply superseded primary/audit labels
Final accepted Wave01 and earlier actual Pro judgments, preserving their field and context scope
reuse_rules: Keep all target ads and their source keys; keep context-level and ad-level counts separate.
Reuse only an exact verified complete judgment-input/context match, including relevant title or metadata if the reviewer used it; raw JOB_HASH alone, fuzzy text and rule similarity are insufficient.
Record direct-ad assignments separately from newly identified exact-context reuse; do not overwrite published Formal800 results or transfer its inference weights to the full frame.
Partial or question-specific reviews cover only expressly judged fields; they cannot establish other fields or full-document nonmention.
Authoritative final masking/unknowns cannot be resurrected from retained primary clauses.
Root supersedes a source only within explicitly adjudicated scope. Other genuine conflicts remain unresolved; do not silently choose newest or majority.
Historical development/evaluation exposure remains a provenance flag; it does not automatically imply a valid semantic label and is not silently discarded from production inventory.
No rule flags, failed model outputs, empty label templates or engineering validator passes count as AI semantic judgments.

coverage_policy.known: Existing supported assignment under its exact field contract; not semantic accuracy certification.
coverage_policy.not_applicable: Only where existing complete judgment establishes no applicable clause; not a replacement for missing work.
coverage_policy.unknown_or_conflict: Reviewed but unresolved or masked; separate from never reviewed.
coverage_policy.partial: Only some relevant clauses/context were judged, or source schema lacks required distinctions.
coverage_policy.candidate_only: Rule extraction exists but no compatible semantic judgment.
coverage_policy.source_unavailable: A completed source is documented but unavailable or cannot be bound; disclose, do not presume coverage.
coverage_policy.multi_clause: Do not call a family complete when an applicable constituent is unresolved; preserve known components privately.

deliverables: Private ad-level per-field provenance/status table without changing original labels
Private deterministic unique-context work queue with required field families and source locators; reviewed-unknown cases distinguished from never-reviewed work
Public field coverage, source coverage, duplicate reuse/conflict/exposure accounting, and exact remaining-context totals
Input/code/output hashes, scheduler receipt, independent QA, concise result report and Git record
conflict_decision: Formal final masked values dominate its own superseded primary/audit versions and cannot be resurrected. An independent complete historical source overlapping a Formal context is flagged for compatibility/uncertainty rather than silently overridden; source precedence is not a substitute for semantic equivalence. Lower partial evidence does not override a complete judgment. No new semantic arbitration in this inventory.
execution: Scheduled SCNet compute only; local code/docs/control-plane/aggregate reading allowed; no API, CLI, BU or new model.
stop_rule: Finish one reconciled coverage inventory and queue. No fresh sampling, parser development, semantic review or manuscript transition in this task.
normalization_binding: Formal800 full reviewer input is exactly the pinned legacy_v5 normalized full text, without semantic title/company metadata. Exact equality of this complete input permits inventory reuse, with raw-identical and normalized-only-identical counts reported separately. Use normalization-only helper; no fresh rule extraction.
